ApplyPosture: feet keep footRot captured before pelvis lean/tilt; footFollow (kneel/lie) lets them follow the shins then floor-push via LowestFootPoint
BodyMatter::Step: held food hangs below the palm: to eat, aim the palm at (mouth + 5cm forward) - (food - palm); bite reach is 6cm from the food's surface
BodyState::Swallow: Stomach only (exp 1.2 game h): drives the 'full' feeling. Food water arrives separately via Intake.ml -> Drink -> bladder. Hunger drops at swallow (satiety). (Stool/bowel was removed on request: pee only.)
BuildTerrainMeshes: Shore colour uses a chamfer distance (m) from under-water samples, not distance to the water box (boxes are bigger than the pond). Tiles of 64x64 quads to fit 16-bit indices.
Character::ApplyTissueContact: breast/glute squash: scales the soft bone along the bone axis closest to world up, volume kept (spread 1/sqrt)
Character::Skin: Perf: morphs applied incrementally (only weights that moved, by dw; full rebuild every ~4000 edits for drift), bone matrices blended per vertex then one transform, all meshes in one ParallelFor (core/Jobs, persistent pool). Meshes masked off by SetSkinMask (hidden materials, unworn garments) are skipped. 0.96 -> 0.39 ms on 2 cores.
Dressing::Step: Grip RISING edge near the path point at garment.off attaches the hand; progress = 0.7*leading hand t + 0.3*other along per-side paths (bottoms: hip->knee->ankle->toes). Hands can't reach past her toes in a crouch, so bottoms finish by STEPPING OUT (off>=0.75, not held, a foot moves 12 cm). justOff blocks the instant re-dress loop (hand at path end holding the new bundle). Motor::SetHandBusy stops the grip closing on other things while it holds a garment.
ExpandPrefabs: Parts get ids instance*1000+n, so Zone::NextId skips _from/spawned entities (else ids explode). Buttons on a cabinet face need ~5 mm standoff from neighbours (Jolt margin) or they never travel.
Learner::Observe: hands are processed before vision so an action and its effect in the same tick get linked; causeWindow 1s
Motor::Ray: rays that skip what she holds (feet would step onto a carried crate)
Motor::StanceTargetsAt: used when a hop changes her frame (rolling over: yaw+pi; bed lie-down/sit-up: yaw+-pi/2 and pos moves); applied on arrival in UpdateStance
Motor::UpdateHands: palm = hand_ capsule (kPalm 8cm past wrist), fingertip = tip_ body used when HandShape::Point; drive stiffness = mass*(2pi f)^2, so light bodies need high freq/mass (tip 0.2kg @15Hz)
on release: withdraw_ pulls the hand back 0.35s before relaxing (else it drops onto levers)
Perception::Sense: SENSOR FIREWALL: entity ids/names/types must never leave this function; tracks are scrambled ids keyed by zone+entity
TestPicksFruit: Jenny must touch, not push, a fruit before gripping: palm target ~7.5 cm from its centre at effort 0.2; pushing into it (4.5 cm) knocks it off the stem (stem holds ~6 N).
World::AirTemperature: heater warmth = W*0.012/(0.25+d^2) C, capped 25 per heater: a 120 W 12 V element is only ~3 C at 45 cm (realistic)
World::Bite: Food is a voxel block (~12 cells on its long side, FoodRt.vox 0 eaten/1 skin/2 flesh). A bite removes the ~12 g of voxels nearest the mouth (in the food's local frame) and marks neighbours as flesh. Unbitten food renders as its plain box; bitten food as x-runs, buried runs skipped.
World::BuildDoor: Door panels must clear the floor (bottom >= ~1 cm): floor friction under a 6 kg door looked like a 3x too-strong seal.
World::BuildEntity: buttons mounted flush on another static body get stuck (Jolt contact margin): give the button base a ~5 mm standoff from the surface it sits on
World::BuildOutdoor: terrain must come before water/onGround entities in the zone list (water autoLevel and onGround read GroundHeight while building). Heightfield res is rounded to a multiple of 4 (Jolt block size).
World::FlowStream: body streams (peeing) start inside her torso collider: they raycast with skipAgent=true; tap streams start 6mm below the spout so they don't hit the tap
World::MainBodyOf: Hash map filled in AddBody (first Main body per entity), cleared in Reset. Was a linear scan of every body; called a lot per step.
World::RayCast: pass skipAgent=true from Jenny's code or rays hit her own hands/torso
World::StepPlants: 4 Hz. Seeds are processed BEFORE plants so watering wets topsoil before roots drink it; roots share puddles (35%/call, max 50 ml). A big tree's roots (spread*growth+0.3 m) drink puddles fast. Seed moisture: soaked*3, dries 0.15/day, needs >0.25 for 2 days. Fruit = food entity + World::Attach point joint to the plant body; JointForce > 6 N (+weight) or ripeness > 1.6 detaches.
World::StepScripts: Never hold a ScriptRt& across a Lua call: callbacks can spawn scripted objects (spawn_object) which grows scripts_ and reallocates. Copy entity/env first, index scripts_[i] for writes. Symptom was a random 'PANIC: unprotected error ... index a nil value'.
World::StepWater: Buoyancy per 2x2x2 sub-cell of each dynamic box, force at each cell centre: gives righting torque (a log lies flat). One force at the centre made logs float upright. Agent bodies skipped (no swimming yet).
ZoneRenderer::Draw: All boxes go into dynamic meshes of 2700 boxes (16-bit indices): 1 draw call per batch. Color in vertex rgb, emissive/4 in vertex alpha. Backface culling off for them (generated winding not consistent).
